attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page gives him no country, no century and no monastery, so he is told from the corpus's other Simons by the day alone, which is why the slug carries it; none of them is kept on 25 June in any calendar. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
